name: Gates of Olympus 1000

features.name: Multipliers up to 1,000x
features.description: The orb range is extended so a single orb can be worth up to 1,000x.

features.name: Free spins
features.description: 15 free spins with a persistent multiplier total; 3 extra scatters retrigger 5 more spins.

features.name: Higher cap
features.description: Max win raised to 15,000x the stake.

review:
Everything you know from Gates of Olympus – same grid, same symbols, same pay-anywhere tumbles – but the multipliers go up to 1,000x and the max win triples to 15,000x.

In practice, it makes an already swingy game even swingier: the average bonus doesn't feel much bigger, but the ceiling is way higher. If you love the original and want more upside, this is the next step. If the original felt too punishing, this won't fix that.
pros: Same easy-to-learn gameplay as the original
cons: Even more volatile than the original
Feels like a remix rather than a new game
author: editorial-team
